Contact Us – We’d Love to Hear from You 💬

Have a question about our calculators? Need help finding your size? Want to share feedback or suggest a new feature? You’re in the right place.

At IMRango, we’re committed to making bra sizing simple, accurate, and accessible for everyone. Your voice matters – whether you’re a regular user, a curious visitor, or someone with a great idea to share.

📧 Email Us

The best way to reach us is by email:

📩 info@iamrango.com

We aim to reply within 24–48 hours (Monday–Friday).

🌐 Follow Us

Stay connected for updates, tips, and new tools:

  • Twitter / X: @iamrango
  • Instagram: @iamrango
  • Facebook: IMRango

🤝 What Can We Help With?

We handle a wide range of inquiries, including:

  • Sizing Questions – “What’s the difference between US and UK sizes?” or “Why did I get different results in ABTF?”
  • Calculator Feedback – “The plus-size calculator gave me an unusual result” or “I’d love to see a [feature] added.”
  • General Help – “How do I measure my underbust correctly?” or “What’s a sister size?”
  • Partnerships & Press – “I’d like to feature IMRango in an article” or “Can I link to your site?”
  • Bug Reports – “The sports bra calculator isn’t working on mobile” – we appreciate the heads-up!
  • Just Saying Hi – We love hearing from users – tell us about your experience! ✨

📝 What to Expect

  • Response Time: We typically reply within 24–48 hours.
  • Privacy: We never share your email or personal information.
  • Sizing Advice: We’re happy to help with general sizing questions, but we recommend trying on bras for the best fit – every body is unique.
  • Feedback Welcome: Your suggestions help us improve. If you have an idea for a new calculator or guide, we’d love to hear it.

🩺 Medical Disclaimer

Please note: IMRango is a measurement resource – we provide sizing estimates based on standard industry formulas. Our calculators are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you have concerns about breast health, chest pain, or any medical condition, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

📍 Where We Are

IMRango is proudly built in Pakistan and available worldwide. We’re a small team passionate about making sizing simple, private, and accessible for everyone.

💜 Stay Connected

We’re always working on new tools and updates. Follow us on social media or check back regularly for new calculators, guides, and improvements.
